headline: 25 notable citizen-written complaints this week in Austin

items.text: Whose idea was it to turn an entire lane on W 35th by Jefferson into a full use bike lane? It is INSANE! Do you have any idea how dangerous that is??!! It needs to be reversed immediately. Who does the entire neighborhood need to contact to get this accident waiting to happen undone??

street light is out for months. very unsafe and dark. i almost got hit by car pulling out of driveway because it was too dark. 311 says its PEC issue. i followed up with PEC and got replied it is City responsibility. please help. This 311 only allows selection for Austin Energy street light. The picture looks to be PEC's. thank you

Submitted a ticket and inspector closed ticket without addressing issue. Illegal dumping, couch and trash was placed on sidewalk near our property fence and sidewalk. The couch is gone but other trash is still on location. The trash is at the corner of alley entrance between SL Davis and Pennsylvania on Chicon Street, heading north. Please remove trash.

lack of street lighting 



Hello,

I request an assessment of the insufficient street lighting in my neighborhood. Poor visibility at night creates safety concerns for pedestrians, drivers, and residents, particularly where vehicles are parked along the street.

Please consider improving the existing lighting or installing additional streetlights.

Thank you for your consideration.

I’ll sit at this light for 3 turns in a lube of 10 cars in order to turn. This needs to be a Michigan left , than a traffic light.

Please please please consider extending the William Cannon & McKinney Falls traffic signal light heading south west and north east. The evening PM rush hour backs up this entire area. Multiple vehicles get in the left turn lane on slaughter heading west (near Sendera Mesa Drive, going to Walgreens), only to learn the drive is blocked.  This forces them to merge right back into traffic from a left turn lane.  Barrels should be placed in the turn lane to close it down until construction is complete.

Congress Avenue downtown 

Drivers routinely park or idle their vehicles weekdays in the north and south bike lanes on Congress Avenue downtown. They know they won’t get ticketed. Can the city occasionally pay mind to these behaviors and ticket these drivers?

Mueller Park Amphitheater is outside the City code for Decibels. I'd like to request a cleanup by Parks Maintenance and speak with whoever oversees maintenance for this particular park. I'd also like to know whether there's a regular cleanup schedule.
